result.reason: The clause adopts the fallback E&O limit of USD 1M and cyber/privacy limit of USD 2M, while retaining statutory workers’ compensation and certificates on request. However, it does not require the playbook’s USD 2M aggregate limit for commercial general liability; it states only USD 1M coverage without distinguishing per-occurrence and aggregate limits. The margin comment does not cure that operative deficiency. The cyber addition is otherwise targeted and professionally integrated without changing unrelated commercial terms.
